lines.1: The afternoon lessons end, and it's time for closing homeroom.
lines.2: Except Inori shows no sign of coming.
lines.5: 「So what do we do? Have Igaguri go fetch Inori again?」
lines.7: 「But that wouldn't be fair to Igaguri.」
lines.9: 「True... Um, Yoppi, what was that silver-haired girl's name again?」
lines.11: 「Tachibana, was it? Would you go to the faculty room and fetch Inori for us?」
lines.13: 「We thought you could take the opportunity to look around the school.」
lines.15: 「But if she's going to tour the school while fetching Inori, she'll need a guide--」
lines.18: 「Leo, if I end up showing her around and we get as far as a kiss, no hard feelings.」
lines.24: 「This is it! After more than a decade of hardship... At last I've reached the age when I can understand the taste of a kiss. Are you watching, Mother...? (← She's alive.)」
lines.27: 「Who else here is named Tsushima? If you're told to guide me, then guide me!」
lines.29: That was an incredibly forceful way to ask.
lines.32: I was honestly happy she'd chosen me as her guide.
lines.34: 「Ellie, you're not plotting something strange again, are you?」
lines.35: 「Nothing strange. I'm thinking of bringing that girl into the student council.」
lines.36: 「What? Ellie, you're planning to recruit Tachibana?」
lines.37: 「She's strong enough to fight Otome on equal terms. Once Otome is gone, she's the obvious choice for my bodyguard.」
lines.38: 「And if I want to win her over, I suppose Tsushima will be the key once again.」
lines.39: 「That bastard Leo, grinning like an idiot and going, 'Hm...? Oh, me?'」
lines.40: 「Here, take this. Stop fuming and let's wait quietly.」
lines.41: 「Ugh... If you think one measly stick of gum is enough to make me quiet, you're dead wrong... Chomp, chomp.」
lines.42: 「Sure, sure. Now let's look forward to the results.」
